detail.longDescription: 🤖 OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says 38,000 ChatGPT queries use as much water as the production of one almond — says data centers use no more water than an office building: “For every 38,000 ChatGPT queries, that is the same amount of water that is used in the production of single almond in California.” submitted by /u/ControlCAD [link] [comments] 📰 Source: Artificial Intelligence (AI) 🔗 Link: https://www.reddit.com/r/artificial/comments/1w78xil/openai_ceo_sam_altman_says_38000_chatgpt_queries/ # DataScience # ChatGPT # AI # ArtificialIntelligence
